title: Outage Refunds
brief:
As a shop owner, I want outages of the shop refunded on our customers' monthly bills, so that customers are compensated when the shop was down for too long.

Acceptance criteria:
- An outage longer than the allowed outage time earns a refund on the bill; a shorter one earns none.
- The longer the outage, the higher the refund level it reaches.
- The part of an outage that lies inside the billing month counts, even if the outage began before the month or ended after it.
- The refund policy writes its durations the way people do, such as "30m" or "1h 30m".

steps.summary: Add the duration parser and the small time helpers it measures with
Add the types: refund levels, policy, outages and the bill
Add the bill generator that measures outages and refunds them on the bill
Add the tests and README section
